Common.name: Babycerasaurus
Common.desc: If this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck.

Common.name: Big Evolution Pill
Common.desc: After this card's activation, it remains on the field, but destroy it during your opponent's 3rd End Phase. Tribute 1 Dinosaur-Type monster to activate this card; while this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon Level 5 or higher Dinosaur-Type monsters without Tributing.

Common.name: Black Brachios
Common.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 monster on the field; change that target to face-up Defense Position.

Common.name: Burial from a Different Dimension
Common.desc: Target up to 3 banished monsters; return them to the GY.

Common.name: Chewbone
Common.desc: FLIP: Special Summon 3 "Chewbone Jr. Tokens" (Zombie-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 300) to your opponent's field in Defense Position.

Common.name: Evilswarm Salamandra
Common.desc: Up to twice per turn: You can banish 1 monster from your Graveyard; this card gains 300 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn.

Common.name: Extinction on Schedule
Common.desc: During the Main Phase: Pay 2000 LP; make both players send all cards they control to the Graveyard at the end of the 3rd Battle Phase after this card's activation.

Common.name: Fossil Dig
Common.desc: Add 1 Level 6 or lower Dinosaur monster from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Fossil Excavation
Common.desc: Activate this card by discarding 1 card, then target 1 Dinosaur-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. Negate the effects of that monster on the field. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

Common.name: Gilasaurus
Common.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If Summoned this way: Activate this effect; your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their GY.

Common.name: Grand Horn of Heaven
Common.desc: During your opponent's Main Phase, when they would Special Summon a monster(s): Negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster, then your opponent draws 1 card, then end the Main Phase.

Common.name: Megalosmasher X
Common.desc: With its sound-baffling armor and gargantuan jaws, this primeval predator's phosphorescence was the only possible pardon for its primitive prey.

Common.name: Miracle Jurassic Egg
Common.desc: While face-up on the field, this card cannot be banished. Each time a Dinosaur-Type monster(s) is sent to your Graveyard, place 2 counters on this card. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the number of counters that were on this card.

Common.name: Miscellaneousaurus
Common.desc: During either player's Main Phase: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; during this Main Phase, Dinosaur-Type monsters you control are unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. You can banish any number of Dinosaur-Type monsters from your Graveyard, including this card; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck with a Level equal to the total number of monsters banished to activate this effect, but destroy it during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Miscellaneousaurus" once per turn.

Common.name: Nightmare Archfiends
Common.desc: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 3 "Nightmare Archfiend Tokens" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 6/ATK 2000/DEF 2000) to your opponent's field in Attack Position. Each time 1 is destroyed, its controller takes 800 damage.

Common.name: Ojama Trio
Common.desc: Special Summon 3 "Ojama Tokens" (Beast-Type/LIGHT/Level 2/ATK 0/DEF 1000) to your opponent's field in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, and each time 1 is destroyed, its controller takes 300 damage.

Common.name: Painful Decision
Common.desc: Send 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, add 1 card with the same name as that card from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Painful Decision" per turn.

Common.name: Quaking Mirror Force
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Change all your opponent's Attack Position monsters to face-down Defense Position. Monsters changed to face-down Defense Position by this effect cannot change their battle positions.

Common.name: Rescue Rabbit
Common.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. You can banish this face-up card you control; Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower Normal Monsters with the same name from your Deck, but destroy them during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Rescue Rabbit" once per turn.

Common.name: Sabersaurus
Common.desc: This normally gentle dinosaur enjoys relaxing in its nest in the prairies. If it becomes angered, it turns terribly ferocious.

Common.name: Sauropod Brachion
Common.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing 1 Dinosaur-Type monster. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Change all other monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position. If this card is attacked, any battle damage your opponent takes from that battle is doubled.

Common.name: Secret Blast
Common.desc: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each card they control. If this card you control is destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to your Graveyard: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Skelesaurus
Common.desc:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with these effects.
● This card becomes EARTH Dinosaur-Type. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon that monster to your field in Defense Position, and if you do, it becomes Zombie-Type.

Common.name: Stegocyber
Common.desc: During damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks while this card is in your Graveyard: You can pay 1000 LP; Special Summon this card, and if you do, you take no battle damage from that battle, but banish this card when it leaves the field (this is a Quick Effect). You can only use this effect of "Stegocyber" once per turn.

Common.name: Super Conductor Tyranno
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. This card cannot declare an attack the turn this effect is activated.

Common.name: Super-Ancient Dinobeast
Common.desc: You can Tribute Summon this card in face-up Attack Position by Tributing 1 Dinosaur monster. When a Dinosaur monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY while this monster is on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can draw 1 card.

Common.name: Survival of the Fittest
Common.desc: Target 1 Dinosaur-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 1000 ATK. When that attacking monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can activate this effect; the equipped monster can make a second attack on an opponent's monster in a row.

Common.name: Swords of Concealing Light
Common.desc: Destroy this card during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation. When this card resolves, change all monsters your opponent controls to face-down Defense Position. Monsters your opponent controls cannot change their battle positions.

Common.name: Terraforming
Common.desc: Add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Trifortressops
Common.desc: During either player's turn, if your opponent Summoned 3 or more monsters this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If Summoned this way, it is unaffected by other cards' effects, but loses 500 DEF during each player's Standby Phase.

Common.name: Twin Twisters
Common.desc: Discard 1 card, then target up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field; destroy them.

Common.name: Tyranno Infinity
Common.desc: The original ATK of this card is the number of your banished Dinosaur-Type monsters x 1000.

Common.name: Ultimate Tyranno
Common.desc: This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. During your Battle Phase, if you control an "Ultimate Tyranno" that can attack, monsters other than "Ultimate Tyranno" cannot attack.

Common.name: Unexpected Dai
Common.desc: If you control no monsters: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from the Deck.

Super Rare.name: Lost World
Super Rare.desc: All monsters on the field lose 500 ATK and DEF, except Dinosaur-Type monsters. Once per turn, if a Dinosaur-Type monster is Normal or Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 "Jurraegg Token" (Dinosaur-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) to your opponent's field in Defense Position. While your opponent controls a Token, they cannot target monsters on the field with card effects, except Tokens. Once per turn, if a Normal Monster(s) on the field would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy that many Dinosaur-Type monsters in your hand and/or Deck instead.

Super Rare.name: Souleating Oviraptor
Super Rare.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can take 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck, and either add it to your hand or send it to the Graveyard. You can target 1 other Level 4 or lower Dinosaur-Type monster on the field; destroy it, then Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your Graveyard in Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Souleating Oviraptor" once per turn.

Super Rare.name: Survival's End
Super Rare.desc: Destroy as many Normal Monsters on the field as possible, and if you do, Special Summon Level 4 or lower Dinosaur-Type monsters from your Deck, up to the number destroyed, but destroy them during the End Phase. You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Dinosaur-Type monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls; destroy them.

Ultra Rare.name: Petiteranodon
Ultra Rare.desc: If this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or higher Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck, but it cannot attack this turn.

Ultra Rare.name: Ultimate Conductor Tyranno
Ultra Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 Dinosaur-Type monsters from your Graveyard. Once per turn, during either player's Main Phase: You can destroy 1 monster in your hand or field, and if you do, change all face-up monsters your opponent controls to face-down Defense Position. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster: You can inflict 1000 damage to your opponent, and if you do, send that Defense Position monster to the Graveyard.
